scenarios.title: Documentation-led dry-run

scenarios.title: Focused context over a full state dump
scenarios.prompt: Which lights are currently on in the kitchen? Use a Home Assistant tool before answering, and keep the query as narrow as the question.

tools.name: get_home_context
tools.description: Return focused Home Assistant context for one area, domain, or entity. Prefer this over listing every entity.

tools.name: get_states
tools.description: Return the state of every entity in Home Assistant. Large response.

scenarios.title: Filtered error log before raw logs
scenarios.prompt: Home Assistant logged something about the MQTT integration this morning. Find out what, using a Home Assistant tool first, and do not pull more log output than the question needs.

tools.name: get_error_log
tools.description: Return the filtered Home Assistant error log: warnings and errors only, already bounded.

tools.name: get_support_logs
tools.description: Return raw Core, Supervisor, host, or add-on logs. Large response; use only when the filtered error log is not enough.

scenarios.title: Read the whole file before rewriting it
scenarios.prompt: Add an automation called 'Porch light at sunset' to automations.yaml. The file already contains other automations. Prepare the change and validate it without persisting anything.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the full current contents of a file.

tools.name: write_config_safe
tools.description: Write a complete Home Assistant YAML configuration file. The content replaces the whole file. Set dry_run true to validate without persisting.

read_file.content:
- id: '1700000000000'
  alias: Morning routine
  triggers:
    - trigger: time
      at: "07:00:00"
  actions:
    - action: light.turn_on
      target:
        entity_id: light.bedroom

scenarios.title: Reload the domain instead of restarting Home Assistant
scenarios.prompt: I have finished editing automations.yaml. Apply the change with the least disruptive action available.

tools.name: call_service
tools.description: Call a Home Assistant service. automation.reload re-reads automations.yaml without interrupting anything else; homeassistant.restart takes the whole instance offline for a minute or more.
